A Ghazi Road venue for your big day

Sadabahar Pearl Marquee is a banquet and marquee hall at 46-E Ghazi Road, in Javed Colony, Nishtar Town, Lahore — a well-known local spot for wedding celebrations and events.

The venue offers dine-in for guests and free parking, so your family and guests can arrive, dine and celebrate without the usual parking worries.

There are no fixed public hours — the marquee opens by booking for events. To check availability for your date, call the venue or send an enquiry on WhatsApp.
